cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set 2025-2026 section G1, which asks for the full 2026-27 academic year: tuition $50,386, required fees $982 (activity fee $292 + health and wellness fee $690), on-campus food and housing $17,127 (double room $8,898 + basic meal plan $8,229). Estimated expenses (G5): books $900, other $1,150 (no transportation figure for residents). The total cost of attendance $73,403 is Elon's published 2026-27 figure for newly admitted students (https://www.elon.edu/u/admissions/undergraduate/financial-aid/tuition-and-aid/); it uses average first-year housing $9,306, books $1,000, transportation $1,500 and miscellaneous $2,000, so it is not the sum of the lines above. Per-credit charge $1,604 (G6). The CDS reports no counts of nonresident aid recipients (H6 numbers blank) although H6 ticks both need-based and non-need-based institutional aid; Elon's international page says it cannot offer need-based aid to non-U.S. citizens, so only merit aid is shown

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2025-2026 (fall 2025 entering class). 18,557 applied, 11,740 admitted (63.3%), 1,333 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state 4,225, out-of-state 13,850, international 482 applicants) add up to the totals, as do the admits and enrolled. International (nonresident) first-years: 482 applied, 308 admitted (64%), 27 enrolled. The early decision figure (353 applied, 304 admitted) covers ED only. Waitlist: 4,214 offered, 835 accepted, 98 admitted. Elon is test-optional (nursing and home-schooled applicants must send scores): 301 enrolled students (23%) submitted SAT and 226 (17%) ACT, so the percentile ranges (SAT composite 1190/1270/1340, ACT composite 25/28/31) describe a self-selected group. The CDS marks standardized test scores 'Not Considered' in C7 and ticks 'Required for some' for every row of C8A, which does not match the admissions pages; the pages' test-optional wording is used. GPA is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (86.42% reported; the CDS does not say whether it is weighted). Class rank was reported by 35%: 20% top tenth, 48% top quarter. Undergraduate enrollment (6,191) and the nonresident count (129) are the 'Total Undergraduates' column of B2.
